content.title: Enjoy National Burrito Day 2026: Grab Puesto’s Burrito BoGo
content.text: National Burrito Day only comes once a year—and in 2026, Puesto is making sure it’s one you won’t forget. Starting on April 2, 2026, celebrate the nation’s favorite food holiday with Puesto’s exclusive Burrito BoGo through DoorDash—buy one burrito, get one free. It’s the perfect excuse to double up on flavor, share with friends, or treat yourself to a second helping of the best burritos in San Diego, Orange County, and the Bay Area. Whether you’re a longtime Puesto fan or trying it for the first time, this is the day to experience what makes our burritos stand out from the rest.Why Choose Puesto for Your Burrito CelebrationPuesto isn’t just celebrating National Burrito Day—we’re redefining it. Each Puesto burrito starts with high-quality ingredients sourced from responsible farmers, ranchers, and fishermen, prepared in a 100% seed oil‑free kitchen. Our recipes are rooted in Mexico City traditions, shaped by family heritage, and elevated through creative craftsmanship. Each burrito is sealed on the placha with Puesto's signature crispy melted cheese, creating a golden, crackling crust that locks in every layer of flavor.Puesto’s Burrito BoGo Offer DetailsFrom April 2 to April 5, 2026, Puesto guests can enjoy our National Burrito Day Burrito BoGo offer through DoorDash: buy one burrito, get one free. Date: Thursday, April 2, 2026 to Sunday, April 5, 2026Redemption: Available during regular business hours at all Puesto locationsEligibility: No purchase minimum Ordering options: Through DoorDash. Either delivery or pickup.How to Redeem Puesto’s Burrito BoGoClaiming your Puesto Burrito BoGo through DoorDash is quick and easy:Download the DoorDash app or web browser. Select the Puesto nearest you.Select your burritos—choose from our signature options featuring premium proteins and fresh, hand-prepared ingredients.Promotion will be applied automatically at checkout.Place your order for pick up or delivery.Quality and Authenticity in Puesto’s BurritosAuthenticity at Puesto means honoring family recipes while evolving them for today’s palate through responsible sourcing and modern technique. Each burrito features hand-prepared salsas, premium proteins, and sustainably grown produce. By cooking exclusively in a seed oil‑free kitchen, every bite reflects both purity of flavor and respect for health‑conscious values.Across San Diego, Orange County, and the Bay Area, guests consistently choose Puesto for burritos that balance tradition, flavor, and creativity—an unmistakable taste of Mexico City with California flair.Enhancing Your Order with Puesto’s Guacamole and CevicheA Puesto burrito experience reaches its peak when paired perfectly with fresh guacamole or ceviche.Try these combinations:Filet Mignon Burrito + Puesto Perfect GuacamoleChicken Al Pastor Burrito + Mango Passionfruit Shrimp CevicheShort Rib Birria Burrito + Local Fish CevicheMushroom Burrito + Nogada GuacamoleFrequently asked questionsBelow are quick answers to common National Burrito Day questions about dates, deals, and where to go. Q: What is National Burrito Day and when is it in 2026?A: National Burrito Day is an annual food holiday celebrated on the first Thursday of April. In 2026, it falls on Thursday, April 2nd. Puesto is celebrating April 2nd through 5th with their BOGO Burrito deal through DoorDash.Q: Where can I find the best burrito deals in San Diego for National Burrito Day 2026?A: Puesto offers straightforward deals across all San Diego, Orange County, and Bay Area locations. Q: What types of burritos are typically featured in National Burrito Day deals?A: Promotions often highlight signature items; Puesto features short rib quesabirria, al pastor, filet mignon, and mushroom burritos. Other restaurants may promote their standard menu items at a discount.Q: How can I get the best burrito deals on National Burrito Day without waiting in long lines?A: Order ahead for pickup or place an order for delivery through DoorDash to skip the lines.Q: Do National Burrito Day deals in San Diego require an app, coupon, or loyalty membership?A: It depends on the restaurant. Puesto's promotion requires only to order through DoorDash to have the BOGO deal automatically applied.
